from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document to support cause-of-action classification."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The exact title of the judgment document as it appears in the text")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific legal cause of action identified in the document (e.g., 'Labor Dispute', 'Construction Contract')")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="The broad nature of the case (e.g., 'Civil', 'Criminal', 'Special Procedure')")
    key_dispute_subject: str | None = Field(description="The primary subject of the legal dispute (e.g., 'Wages', 'Traffic Accident Liability', 'Contract Validity')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgments: list[JudgmentInfo]
